description: This PHP source file defines the UserMigration class, which handles migrating user, account, and permission data within the Revive Adserver project, including language mappings, account creation, and user permission assignments.

classes.name: UserMigration
classes.description: A class for migrating users, roles, accounts, and permissions in Revive Adserver, including language mapping and account management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserMigration class, loads language settings for admin and agencies, and logs the process.

methods.name: _migrateUsers
methods.description: Migrates user data from source to target database, creating accounts, users, and permissions, and handling special cases for admin accounts.

methods.name: _insertAccountAccess
methods.description: Creates an association between an account and a user.

methods.name: _insertAccountPermissions
methods.description: Assigns permissions to a user for a specific account.
